note: PatchCore (Roth et al. 2022): torchvision wide_resnet50_2 layer2+layer3, 1% approximate greedy coreset of every-4th-frame training patches, leave-one-video-out calibration, 3-frame per-video median filter

config.backbone: torchvision wide_resnet50_2, IMAGENET1K_V1, eval, no grad, fp32
config.input: native frame, RGB (gray replicated), INTER_AREA to 224x224, ImageNet mean/std
config.features: layer2 (512x28x28) and layer3 (1024x14x14), each 3x3 avg pool stride 1 pad 1; layer3 bilinear to 28x28; concat 1536; adaptive_avg_pool1d to 1024 per location
config.memory_bank_candidates: patches of every 4th sampled frame of each training video
config.coreset: approximate greedy k-center, fraction 0.01 of candidates, 128-d fixed Gaussian projection (unscaled, torch seed 0), random start (seed 0)
config.score: frame = max over 784 patches of min L2 distance to bank (k=1), fp32
config.calibration: ALL training frames, leave-one-video-out (own-video bank entries excluded)
config.smoothing: none in this file; 3-frame per-video median filter in assemble_patchcore.py
